listing.summary: Adds various custom-made ships to the game, including the Ark Royal heavy capital ship.

description: Adds various custom-made ships to the game, including the Ark Royal heavy capital ship. The Ark Royal features a heavy armament of chainguns, machine guns, and missile launchers, but lacks shields and point defense systems.
